fact: As of July 2026, my construction is in the final stages of completion! Scaffolding is coming down, and resident move-ins and handovers are scheduled to take place this month (July 2026).
We are currently in July 2026. Handovers are occurring this month, and display apartments are open for viewing by appointment.
A brand new Willing Coffee shop is set to open on my ground floor this month (July 2026) alongside Bar Vino in the Mt Lawley precinct, serving European cafe culture to residents and the community.

I feature advanced acoustic engineering by Klopper & Davis Architects. This includes heavy double-glazed windows, solid concrete floor slabs, and specialized high-performance wall insulation designed to isolate my internal residences from the nearby East Perth rail line and local street activity.
Over 60% of my 30 grandly proportioned residences have been sold. Completed display apartments can be viewed by booking an appointment with sales agents Adam Nguyen, Steve Plummer, or Louise Neal.

I was designed by Klopper & Davis Architects in a Flatiron-inspired angular form, reviving Mount Lawley's industrial heart. Landscape architecture was done by CAPA, integrating native plantings at my base.

My developer is Willing Property. They use an integrated model where their building arm, Willing Build, constructs the project directly to ensure high craftsmanship and eliminate third-party builder risks.

My structure is built with post-tensioned reinforced concrete slabs, exposed concrete columns, and large, deep-cantilevered private balconies that offer panoramic views of the Perth city skyline, Swan River, and Darling Scarp.

Mt Lawley's industrial heart was historically defined by trade depots and brick factories. My design pays homage to this heritage with strong geometric shapes, charcoal steel accents, and robust masonry.
